name: linear-link
description: The session's Linear ticket with its state and Figma frames, and how far its merged pull request has deployed, as links above the message box

workspace.title: Linear workspace
workspace.description: The workspace's URL key, the acme in linear.app/acme/issue/ACME-1, for a link before the pull request body carries one

linearApiKey.title: Linear API key
linearApiKey.description: A personal API key from Linear (Settings > Security & access), to show each ticket's Figma frames and exact URL. Stored in secure storage. Optional.

stages.title: Deploy stages
stages.description: Branches a merged pull request moves through, in order, as branch=label pairs: main=dev, qa=qa, prod=prod shows on dev, on qa or on prod. Empty hides the stage.
